description: painterly pixel art in the style of Eastward, 3/4 top-down view with fronts drawn straight-on (not isometric), sunlight from the upper left, full value range from deep cool shadows to bright warm highlights, hue-shifted colour ramps, adaptive dark coloured outlines (never pure black), chunky readable silhouette, no text + a tree trunk with root flare only — NO foliage, NO leaves, no ground, centred on a transparent background + bark in warm browns with vertical grain ridges, moss patches at the base, root flare spreading at the bottom, darker shaded side on the right + cool highland pine forest palette
item_descriptions: sturdy broadleaf tree trunk, straight with a slight lean, wide root flare, in the described style
maple tree trunk, smooth grey-brown bark with horizontal lenticel marks, in the described style
slender willow trunk with a gentle S-curve, fibrous bark texture, in the described style
cherry tree trunk with dark mahogany bark and a few bare lower branches, in the described style
